digest.component_or_area: rebar llm structured run and failure handling
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregated whole-run usage (requests and output_tokens summed across all attempts) in memory, telemetry, and exactly one durable JSONL row without per-attempt or candidate-request fields.

Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain (UnexpectedModelBehavior -> ToolRetryError -> ModelRetry -> StructuredOutputError); repeated-truncation exhaustion with no Rebar object on the chain must construct and raise a fresh UnretryableOutputError.
Terminal failure diagnostics must preserve consumed requests, tool calls, and provider-reported tokens without inventing usage values for calls that did not report them.
Complete final provider responses must be written to artifacts only at terminal failure when artifact capture is enabled, without mutating earlier retry-wire omissions.
Historical usage rows and pricing calculations must remain byte-compatible except for approved higher counters following successful retries, with no new core usage fields.
